subject: FinTechCo — Deployment mode & integration follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: FinTechCo — Deployment mode & integration follow-up

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying questions so we can scope the right deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private/VPC or on-prem):

Summary from our call:
- Main workloads: real-time transaction enrichment (low-latency) + nightly offline batch embedding jobs.
- Sensitive PII tokenization and audit requirements; security is a hard constraint for production.
- Current infra: GCP (us-central1), internal SSO via Okta, centralized KMS backed by HSM for key material.

Open qualification items (please confirm):
1) SSO / identity: you mentioned SAML + SCIM for provisioning — do you need SCIM for group sync and automated user provisioning, or is SAML-only sufficient for the initial rollout?
2) KMS / HSM: you stated keys must be customer-managed and stored in your HSM (Cloud HSM). Is integrating Redwood Dedicated with your KMS enough, or do you require a Private deployment where Redwood services are deployed inside your VPC with direct HSM access?
3) Logging & retention: what are your required retention windows for request/response logs and audit trails? You mentioned legal asked for longer-term retention — can you confirm target (e.g., 1 year, 3 years, 7 years)? Also: do you need delivery of raw logs to your SIEM (Cloud Logging export / S3) or will Redwood-hosted logs with export-on-request suffice?
4) Data residency / processing: are there any restrictions that require on-prem or APAC-only processing?

Next steps I propose:
- If you confirm SCIM + customer KMS/HSM + long retention (>3 years) we should plan a technical deep-dive with Dev and Rishi to discuss Private deployment options and network architecture.
- I attached a short "deployment requirements" workbook that captures SSO/KMS/audit needs — please fill the highlighted tabs and return.

Attachments: FT-Deployment-Requirements.xlsx (workbook), redwood_private_requirements.pdf (short overview)

Would love your confirmation on the 4 bullets above — happy to sync today or tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0118

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechco.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 13:40:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCo — Deployment mode & integration follow-up

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Answers inline below.

1) SSO/SCIM: We do want SCIM for group sync (we manage roles at the IdP level). SAML-only would be a blocker for provisioning automation.

2) KMS/HSM: We require customer-managed keys. Our security policy requires the key material to be stored in our HSM (Cloud HSM on GCP). Ideally we want Redwood to integrate with our KMS key wrapping so keys never leave our control. If that integration can be achieved with Redwood Dedicated (private network peering + customer KMS integration), that would be preferable to a full Private on-prem rollout. Full on-prem isn't required if Dedicated can meet the KMS/HSM integration and network isolation requirements.

3) Logging & retention: Legal requires 7-year retention for specific audit logs (access and admin actions). For request/response logs we can accept a shorter window (90 days) as long as we have a mechanism to export/store them to our GCS bucket. We need automated export to our logging bucket (GCS) and an option to push to our SIEM (Splunk).

4) Data residency: All processing must occur in us-central1 for production. No APAC requirement at present.

Next steps:
- We'll fill out the workbook and return it by EOD Friday.
- Please schedule a technical deep-dive with your infra folks (Dev and Rishi) next week — we need to validate the KMS integration approach and network topology.

CC'ing Priya (security) for any additional requirements.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering
FinTechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com | +1 617-555-0199

Alex / Priya —

Great, thanks for confirming — that's very helpful. Quick plan based on your answers:

1) SCIM required: we'll include the SCIM integration checklist in the tech deep-dive. Dev will run through our SCIM mapping and group-sync implementation.
2) KMS/HSM: since Dedicated may be workable, we'll scope two proposals: (A) Dedicated with private peering + KMS integration (key wrapping & enveloping with your Cloud HSM) and (B) Private/VPC deployment where we deploy a customer-isolated control plane inside your VPC. We'll call out trade-offs: deployment effort, SLA, and supported maintenance windows.
3) Logs & retention: we'll confirm automated export to your GCS bucket and a Splunk export path. For the 7-year audit retention items, we may store those in your GCS bucket via export and provide retrieval tooling.
4) Region: we'll confirm node placement in us-central1.

Action items / next steps:
- Please upload the completed FT-Deployment-Requirements.xlsx to the Drive folder (link below) by EOD Friday.
- I'll schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive next Tue (Feb 24) 10:00–11:00am CST — invite to follow. Dev and Rishi will lead.
- I'll include a short pre-read (network diagrams + sample KMS integration flow) in the invite.
